title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: which Current Balance is compared on a money market upgrade request
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks to move the account up to the highest-ranked money market tier they qualify for. It fixes the figure that is compared with each money market tier's minimum opening deposit, and when that figure may be used.

## Policy clause

1. The figure compared with each tier's minimum is the account's Current Balance after every refund owed on the account has posted.
2. When the owner moves money out of the account in the same contact, the figure compared is the Current Balance after that transfer has posted.
3. The upgrade policy is applied only when no transaction on the account has a posted date later than the current date, as the ledger shows, so that every transfer and refund the figure must reflect has posted. A transfer or refund made on a Saturday, Sunday or Federal Reserve holiday posts on the next business day, and until it has posted no target is chosen under the upgrade policy. This is a condition for applying the policy, read from the records; the target worked out from the figures does not test it.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** The Current Balance and the posted dates are read from the savings account record and its transaction record at the moment the target is chosen. An amount the customer expects to receive, or a transfer not yet posted, does not count until it has posted.
- **Object correlation.** Only refunds owed on this savings account, and transfers out of this savings account in the contact, enter this figure.

## Input, judgement, output

| Situation on the account | Figure compared with the tier minimums |
|---|---|
| no refund owed, no transfer out in the contact | the Current Balance as it stands |
| refunds owed, all posted | the Current Balance including them |
| a transfer out made in the contact, posted | the Current Balance after that transfer |
| any transaction with a posted date later than the current date | none; no target is chosen under the upgrade policy until it has posted |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures; the USD 5000.00 minimum is illustrative, not a tier value)

- **Refund owed.** The Current Balance is USD 4995.00 and a fee refund of USD 9.00 is owed on the account. Once the refund has posted, the Current Balance is USD 5004.00, which is at least USD 5000.00, so that tier's minimum is reached. The USD 4995.00 figure is not the one compared.
- **Transfer out in the contact.** The Current Balance is USD 7000.00 and the owner moves USD 2500.00 out in the contact. The figure compared is USD 4500.00, after the transfer has posted, which falls short of USD 5000.00.
- **Weekend contact.** On a Saturday the owner makes a transfer that will post on the next business day. A transaction then carries a posted date later than the current date, so no target is chosen under the upgrade policy until it has posted.

## Points of judgement

**Wrong reading:** "Use the Current Balance shown at the start of the call." **Correct basis:** use the Current Balance after every refund owed has posted and after any transfer out made in the contact has posted.
